about: At the helm of Prosper Injury Attorneys in North Miami Beach, founder and trial attorney Prosper Shaked has built a practice dedicated to representing individuals and families across Florida in personal injury, medical malpractice, wrongful death, catastrophic injury and complex negligence matters.

A Miami Beach native, Mr. Shaked's path to the courtroom began with a B.B.A. from Emory University, followed by a J.D., cum laude, from the University of Miami School of Law. He holds admission to The Florida Bar and to the United States District Court for the Southern District of Florida. His professional standing has been affirmed through sustained peer recognition: inclusion in The Best Lawyers in America for Personal Injury Litigation – Plaintiffs in both 2026 and 2027, preceded by four straight years on the Best Lawyers: Ones to Watch list from 2022 to 2025.

Long before founding his own firm in 2017, Mr. Shaked cut his teeth as an assistant state attorney in Miami-Dade County, where he prosecuted serious criminal cases and tried more than 30 matters to verdict. That trial-tested foundation – forged in high-stakes courtroom environments – still informs the way he builds civil cases today. Meticulous evidence development, rigorous case preparation and genuine trial readiness aren't afterthoughts in his practice; they're the framework from day one.

Mr. Shaked deliberately keeps his caseload selective, a choice that lets him stay personally engaged in every matter his firm takes on. From the earliest investigation and presuit groundwork through litigation, expert discovery, settlement talks and trial preparation, he directs strategy himself rather than delegating it away. This hands-on approach suits the nature of his docket, which often centers on contested liability, intricate medical causation, catastrophic injuries, high-value damages and cases demanding substantial expert testimony.
